messages:
sara: Hey—brought up reranker v2.1 (unquant) in staging. Baseline NDCG@10=0.763, MRR=0.412.
kevin: Oof. Is that on the same holdout? seeds/batching identical?
dmitri: Data snapshot used: holdout-2026-03-14 (10k queries). Candidate ordering preserved? kvpack enabled?
sara: ordering preserved, kvpack=on. Batching was default (auto). Seed=42. We ran PTQ with per-channel scale.
jules: can you paste the eval harness command and the scoring summary?
sara: ```
./eval_harness --model rerank/v2.1 --quant int8 --holdout holdout-2026-03-14 
--candidates 100 --seed 42 --kvpack true
```
ci-bot: deploy-check: quantization job 2981 completed. logs: https://ci/2981
kevin: quick sanity: run unquantized w/ same batch/kvpack settings and one-off small subset (1k) to confirm effect scale.
dmitri: also try turning kvpack off for quant run; earlier we saw kvpack+int8 can skew relative scores due to ordering/kv offsets.
sara: results from 1k quick runs:
- unquant: NDCG@10 0.765 MRR 0.413
- int8 kvpack on: NDCG@10 0.747 MRR 0.405
- int8 kvpack off: NDCG@10 0.754 MRR 0.409
jules: interesting — kvpack seems to amplify the drop. Could be accumulation of roundoff across packed KV. Anything in tokenizer/priming changed?
sara: we recently changed doc concatenation to add "\n---\n" separator for long docs. That was in bringup PR 789.
kevin: that could shift tokenization boundaries causing different attention kv shapes. Can you re-run int8+kvpack but with old concatenation (space) as a control?
sara: running now on 1k subset, will post brief.
... (10m later)
sara: control run finished:
- int8 kvpack on + old-concat: NDCG@10 0.751 MRR 0.407
kevin: delta reduced but not gone. Plan: 1) run determinism check (no batching, seed fixed), 2) run int8 PTQ with per-tensor vs per-channel, 3) inspect top k score shifts for affected queries.
dmitri: I can do top-k diffs. If the top-1 switches for many queries it's a calibration issue; if it's low-ranked shuffles then it's numeric noise.
jules: add a quick eval to compute per-query NDCG delta distribution (cdf). If median delta small but tail large then it's specific slices.
sara: assigning: dmitri -> top-k diffs + per-query delta; kevin -> PTQ config sweep (per-tensor vs per-channel, sym/affine); jules -> rerun with old concat full 10k maybe overnight.
ci-bot: reminder: this thread will be archived in 30d :calendar:
kevin: FYI I saw similar pattern on a long-form anchor cohort earlier; kvpack exacerbated int8 errors for docs > 1024 tokens.
sara: thanks team. Will collect artifacts and open a ticket with repro steps + small sample for model team.
